content:
Maria Chen: Heads up — aurora-8b-qlora-4bit that went live last night is showing odd behavior in production. Users report repeated short phrases and p95 latency spikes.
Ashok Patel: saw a couple of alerts too. any correlation with traffic/load?
Maria Chen: not obvious. error rate up ~3% on codebench prompts, p95 ~410ms vs expected 220ms. repetition on structured outputs (json/code) mostly.
Jules Rivera: can you paste an example prompt + response (redact user data)?
Maria Chen: here’s a sanitized example: 
```
prompt: "Write a python function to merge two dicts"
response: "def merge(a,b):
    result = {}
    for k in a:
        result[k] = a[k]
    for k in b:
        result[k] = b[k]
    return result
    return result
    return result
"
```
Maria Chen: note the triple repeated return lines. happens intermittently.
Eva Li: was this the QLoRA 4-bit build we onboarded? or the fallback fp16?
Maria Chen: traffic hits qlora-4bit by routing policy. fallback fp16 is available and shows normal outputs.
Priya N: ci-bot shows deploy at 1813400000 -> aurora-8b-qlora-4bit:v1.1.
ci-bot: deploy recorded: aurora-8b-qlora-4bit v1.1 -> prod (canary 10%) by @jules at 2026-07-15T03:12:20Z
Tom G: quick checks — could be tokenizer alignment after quantization or KV cache handling when sharding across GPUs. Any kvcache error logs?
Maria Chen: no explicit kvcache errors. logs show repeated token emit with same attention key id. snippet: 
```
[2026-07-15T03:20:44Z] TRACE decode: token=return, attention_key=0x7f3a, kv_index=512
[2026-07-15T03:20:44Z] TRACE decode: token=return, attention_key=0x7f3a, kv_index=512
[2026-07-15T03:20:44Z] TRACE decode: token=return, attention_key=0x7f3a, kv_index=512
```
Ashok Patel: interesting. suggests duplicate read from KV or loop in decode path. can you repro locally with --seed and --stream=false?
Maria Chen: starting a repro on staging now. command: 
```
redwood local run --model aurora-8b --variant qlora-4bit --prompt-file examples/merge_dicts.py --stream false --seed 42
```
Jules Rivera: also compare with --variant fp16 to confirm regressions are only in qlora-4bit.
Eva Li: schedule: if canary >10% we should consider rollback to fp16 and pause qlora until triage. impact looks non-critical but degrades quality.
Priya N: agree. customer tickets are trickling in but not major outages. SLOs still met but quality regressions matter.
Tom G: quick perf note — p95 spike could be kernel fallback under certain sequence lengths. check runtime logs for 'kernel_fallback=true' messages.
sre-robot: alert: p95 latency spike detected for model aurora-8b-qlora-4bit between 03:15-03:30 UTC. max concurrent inferences: 48.
Maria Chen: repro confirmed on staging: duplicated tokens reproducible with seed 42. switching to fp16 fixes it. saving traces and attaching to /tmp/aurora-trace-1813456789.tar.gz
Ashok Patel: next steps I propose: 1) rollback canary to fp16 2) block qlora-4bit variant from routing 3) run bisect between v1.0 and v1.1 quant configs 4) run kernel trace with SHM logging
Jules Rivera: + run our code-eval suite to quantify regression (unit tests, code-llama style tests) and add a prompt set where repetition happens for regression alerts.
Eva Li: I’ll open a P0 intake in the model-onboarding tracker with steps and attach the traces.
Maria Chen: done: intake https://redwood.internal/models/INTAKE-4523 (added traces, repro steps, suggested rollback).
Priya N: who owns the triage? Jules?
Jules Rivera: I can start. will ping infra for kernel logs + profiling.
Tom G: I’ll look at quantizer config differences and check if the 4-bit group size changed.
ci-bot: rollback action queued: rollback aurora-8b-qlora-4bit -> fp16 canary at 03:46 UTC.
Maria Chen: thanks. I’ll monitor tickets and post updates. try to keep customers informed (short note: we’re rolling back variant while we investigate). :thumbsup:
Eva Li: thanks team. keep thread updated.
Jules Rivera: if anyone has extra reproducer prompts, paste them here. saves time.
Maria Chen: adding two more repro prompts to the intake.
Tom G: logging follow-up: will upload kernel profiles to the intake by EOD.
sre-robot: note: rollback succeeded at 03:46:12 UTC, canary now on fp16. no more p95 spikes observed in next 10 minutes sample.
Maria Chen: closing loop for now, will reopen if new reports surface.
